Re: Appeal of adverse benefit determination  
Member: Quinn Grant  
Member ID: W331641494  
Reference number: POC-5BC8A5312C-11722  
Requested service: Anterior cervical discectomy and fusion at C5-C6  
CPT: 22551  
Date of denial notice: August 10, 2026

Dear Dean Health Plan Appeals Department:

I appeal the denial of prior authorization for the requested C5-C6 anterior cervical discectomy and fusion. The stated reason for denial is that the submitted records did not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment. The records do document extensive conservative treatment, persistent symptoms, objective neurologic findings, and imaging-confirmed nerve-root compression.

Quinn Grant has experienced 24 months of progressive neck pain that has not been relieved by rest. The symptoms include radicular pain and numbness extending into the right thumb and index finger, together with weakness. Examination documented positive provocative testing on the affected side and a neurologic deficit corresponding to the imaged level.

The submitted records document the following conservative treatment:

- Supervised physical therapy for 16 weeks, from March 4, 2026, through June 24, 2026.
- Sixteen completed physical therapy visits, including cervical traction and postural training, as documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- NSAID treatment for four months, with inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on April 21, 2026, which provided only four weeks of partial relief.

Despite these measures, Quinn continues to have significant radicular symptoms, numbness, weakness, and functional impairment. The July 13, 2026, cervical MRI shows a C5-C6 disc herniation with severe right foraminal narrowing and compression of the C6 nerve root. The clinical symptoms and neurologic examination correspond to the MRI findings. These records establish that nonoperative treatment was attempted for a substantial period and did not provide adequate or durable relief.

The patient also has no documented active infection or untreated substance-use condition, has a BMI of 29, and is a nonsmoker. Marchetti, MD, orthopedic surgeon, has requested the procedure based on the persistent symptoms, failed conservative treatment, objective neurologic deficit, and MRI-confirmed C6 nerve-root compression.

I request reversal of the denial and authorization of CPT 22551 for the medically necessary C5-C6 anterior cervical discectomy and fusion. Please review the complete prior authorization packet, including the physical therapy discharge note, medication history, injection history, MRI report, examination findings, and the surgeon’s clinical assessment.

I was unable to identify a publicly available Dean Health Plan medical policy containing the medical-necessity criteria applied to this request. Accordingly, this appeal does not quote or attribute any policy language to Dean Health Plan. Please provide the specific medical policy or clinical-review criteria used in this determination, including its title, policy number, effective date, and the precise documentation requirement that Dean believes was not met. Please also provide the clinical-review rationale and identify any records considered missing or insufficient.

Please send the appeal determination and the requested criteria to:

Quinn Grant  
[Mailing address]  
[Telephone number]  
[Email address]

Sincerely,

Quinn Grant  
Member ID: W331641494
